decisions.statement: A playlist is made under the account the token is held for.
A playlist made here is private.
A track reaches a playlist as a uri rather than as an id.
One call adds a hundred tracks at most.
More tracks than one call holds are added over as many calls as it takes.
Tracks reach the playlist in the order they were handed over.
Nothing here chooses which tracks a playlist holds.

definition: a playlist of Alan's made and filled over the Web API
